text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- National police commander Fernando da Piedade "Nando" said violence which accompanied recent ceremonies extending state administration to UNITA-contolled territory would not be tolerated in future. He also announced a temporary halt to the quartering of the Rapid Intervention Police, known as the Ninjas.
- The governor of Huila province announced that the Rapid Intervention Police would accompany delegate to UNITA-controlled areas for ceremonies where state administration was to be extended.
- A group of UNITA supporters took down the state flag at the airport in M'Banza Congo on Wednesday, for the second time in two weeks.
